What are the best new science games this September?

Game Based Learning - Science Games

Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 4:12
Instaread

Looking for new science games this September? Legends of Learning just added four classroom titles: Fix The Ship: It Matters! (properties of matter for grades K–2, NGSS 2-PS1.A-2), Energy Defense Unit (natural resources, NGSS MS-ESS3.A-1), Robo Recharge Restore (electrical energy, NGSS ES-PS3.B-3), and Sound Wave Surfer (sound waves, NGSS MS-PS4.A-2). All are free for teachers to assign.

What’s new in science for September 2026?

Fix The Ship: It Matters! — properties of matter (K–2)

An alien scientist has crash-landed — and the ship won’t fly without repairs. In Fix The Ship: It Matters!, students test materials, discover properties like hardness, flexibility, absorbency, and transparency, and choose the right objects to fix damaged systems.

What teachers are saying

Mike: A straightforward introduction to matter and its properties. Students repair a spaceship for an alien by testing materials — clearly connects to the content and is great as an intro activity.

Michele: Eye-appealing graphics and a cute alien character make it accessible for all students. Learners virtually test, observe, and record material properties, then apply structure-to-function thinking to repair the ship. Ideal as an introductory activity with a built-in end-of-game assessment.

Play / assign: teachers.legendsoflearning.com/games/4813

Energy Defense Unit — natural resources (grades 6–8)

Energy Defense Unit is a training simulation where students learn Earth’s renewable and nonrenewable resources. In action stages, they generate energy and defend a base; in knowledge stages, they match statements to the resources they describe.

(Thumbnail → GIF → Educational)

What teachers are saying

Katie: Players simulate how different renewable and nonrenewable resources can be used to generate energy — all while defeating enemies.

Michele: Engaging core concept where students can play in pairs and get excited about placing units to defend against enemies. Strong natural-resources focus for a middle school energy unit.

Play / assign: teachers.legendsoflearning.com/games/4744

Robo Recharge Restore — electrical energy (grades 6–8)

Help three robots restore a broken power plant in Robo Recharge Restore. Students explore the facility, connect circuits, manage power, and repair systems — learning how electrical energy moves from batteries and solar panels to lights and machines.

What teachers are saying

Mike: An overview of electrical energy set in a space station where a robot fixes things. Progresses from basic circuits to wiring solar panels, with explanations and multiple-choice questions after each stage — perfect for a unit review.

Michele: Vibrant graphics and smooth animations with mini-games that keep attention. Immediate feedback and retries create a risk-free practice space; tip — have students play in pairs so they don’t skip the reading sections.

Play / assign: teachers.legendsoflearning.com/games/4754

Sound Wave Surfer — sound waves (grades 6–8)

Sound Wave Surfer puts students in the role of a trainee sound engineer. Guide sound pulses through air, water, steel, foam, and vacuum while adjusting wave features — reinforcing that a sound wave needs a medium to travel.

What teachers are saying

Rebecca M: My class really enjoyed this!

Christin: Use it to teach sound waves. Students enjoy matching sound waves and exploring sonar, and they investigate different mediums and how waves travel through them.

Play / assign: teachers.legendsoflearning.com/games/4820

How to assign (free for teachers)

  1. Create a free teacher account at legendsoflearning.com.
  2. Search the game title (or browse Science by grade / NGSS).
  3. Add to a playlist and assign to your class.

FAQ

What new science games came out in September 2026?
Four titles: Fix The Ship: It Matters! (K–2), Energy Defense Unit, Robo Recharge Restore, and Sound Wave Surfer (grades 6–8).

Are they free for teachers?
Yes — create a free account and assign games to your class.

What NGSS topics do they cover?
Properties of matter (2-PS1.A-2), natural resources (MS-ESS3.A-1), transfer of electrical energy (ES-PS3.B-3), and sound waves (MS-PS4.A-2).

Which game is best for early elementary?
Fix The Ship: It Matters! — grades K–2, ~12 minutes, properties of matter.

Can students play on Chromebooks?
Yes — games run in the browser and can be assigned for class or homework.
